jobs.purpose: Ringo concept A (clay, ring on nose)
jobs.prompt: Original mascot character design named Ringo: an adult California sea lion (not a seal) with clearly recognizable sea-lion anatomy: small external ear flaps, long front flippers, sleek tapered body, short whiskers, sitting upright on its rear flippers. Ringo calmly balances a single lime-green ring (#76B900) upright on the tip of its nose, looking slightly toward the viewer. The ring has exactly one small, restrained magenta (#E20074) band near its bottom. Body: deep charcoal slate (#2C322E) with a slightly lighter warm grey belly. Personality: observant, calm, friendly, dependable, slightly playful; understated expressive dark eyes with small catchlights, gentle closed-mouth smile. Finish: hand-sculpted matte polymer clay figure with controlled fine texture and subtle tool marks, soft directional studio light from upper left, soft contact shadow. Plain seamless warm white (#F7F7F2) studio background. Full body visible, centered, strong clear silhouette, generous margin. No text, no letters, no logo, no badge, no armor, no costume, no robot parts, no emoji face, not childish.

jobs.purpose: Hero motion loop (start frame = end frame = hero still for a seamless loop)

jobs.prompt: Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cut. The sea lion stays seated in exactly the same place. No animals, no people, no boats, no text, no letters, no logo, no border.
